channel.title: ClearDeck guides
channel.description: Short, practical walkthroughs of every part of ClearDeck — a local network firewall for Android.

item.title: Install ClearDeck and turn on protection
item.description: What ClearDeck needs from your phone, why it asks for a VPN connection, and how to get protection running in about two minutes.

item.title: Keep protection running
item.description: Why the tunnel drops on reboot, how Android's always-on VPN fixes it, and what to do when a phone manufacturer keeps killing it.

item.title: Understand the dashboard
item.description: What each number and chart on the ClearDeck dashboard actually measures, and how to read it without fooling yourself.

item.title: See and control what each app does online
item.description: The per-app view, the access log, and how a single log entry becomes a rule that applies to one app or to everything.

item.title: Rule lists: the five modules and your own
item.description: What ships inside ClearDeck, how to import your own block and allow lists, and how link subscriptions stay up to date.

item.title: Deep inspection and the certificate
item.description: What deep inspection adds, why it needs a certificate on your phone, how to install and remove it, and the honest limits of the technique.

item.title: Power saving and battery use
item.description: What a local firewall really costs to run, measured honestly — 20.67 seconds of CPU per half hour — and exactly what the power-saving switch trades away to lower it.

item.title: Export the access log as CSV
item.description: What ClearDeck's access-log CSV actually contains, why it is UTF-8 with a BOM, and how to sort and filter it to find the apps and trackers that try hardest to reach out.

item.title: When protection will not start
item.description: A scan-down checklist for the usual reasons ClearDeck's tunnel will not come up or quietly stops filtering, ordered from most likely cause to least, with a check for each one.
